what: When a paper panel enters the screen, it stretches 1.5× horizontally from the right 50% and, blurred at 10px (left anchored), shrinks into place over 1s while clearing. One second later, gold-foil edge bands grow from 0 in their own directions over 1s (left band top to bottom, right band bottom to top, bottom band right to left), and the text blocks inside float up one after another, .2s apart, clearing their blur

options.dur: Panel, strip and text duration (s), default 1 — the original phone is .5
options.band: Time before band and text come in (s), default 1 — original phone .5
options.each: Gap between text chunks (sec), default .2 — the original phone value is .1
options.repeat: If 1, it folds when leaving the screen and spins again each time it is raised. Default: once
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel that expands and lifts in (child). If none, the element itself is the panel
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Text blocks to rise in turn (optional)
options.--fx-shift · --fx-stretch · --fx-blur ·: Panel shift, horizontal scale, blur, text rise (CSS variables), default 50% · 1.5 · 10px · 1.3vw

from.where: index.html .bf-sec (pop-up gold-foil paper section) — in the original at .is-insert, the panel goes opacity 0 · translate 50% 0 · scale 1.5 1 · blur 10px (origin left) → 1s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), band span 1·2·3 scale 1 0 (top)·1 0 (bottom)·0 1 (right) → 1s with a 1s delay, lead·date·place 1s with delays of 1s·1.2s·1.4s. On phones everything is halved

note: The hidden position of text blocks (1.3vw lower) is a value guessed from the screen, because the original computed style could not be read. If the page uses an inner scroll panel (locomotive etc.), attach [data-fx-scroller] so that panel becomes the visibility reference
